title: Pupil's vocabulary log (lesson 95)
subject: English
source: Written for english/y3 lesson 96 (Pupil's vocabulary log (lesson 95))
intro: Lesson 96: Planning the Pompeii narrative: an ordinary morning to a change in tone. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Box
Event
Tone
rows: Livia wakes and helps her father bake bread
She carries loaves to the forum; the ground shivers
A huge cloud rises over Vesuvius
Livia and her family leave the town by cart

parts.text: Where: a small bakery near the forum
Senses: warm bread, birds, cart wheels

panels.title: Our story rules
points: Told by a child in Pompeii
Show fear through senses, not injuries

keywords.def: a plan in boxes showing the order of events
the feeling of the writing: calm, tense
where and when a story happens

questions.q: Write a calm sentence for box 1
questions.a: For example: Warm bread filled the bakery with a sweet smell.

questions.q: Core: complete the four-box storyboard with notes and a tone word for each box
questions.a: Four boxes with events and tone words

questions.q: Extend: add two powerful words from Pliny's letter to boxes 3 and 4
questions.a: For example: engulfed, blacker than any night

questions.q: Stretch: tell your story aloud to a partner in a breakout room
Which sentence has a tense tone?
options: Livia hummed as she shaped the loaves.
The sun warmed the stone street.
The ground shivered and the birds fell silent.
questions.a: C) The ground shivered and the birds fell silent.. Shivering ground and sudden silence create tension. The others are calm.
